in_marathi.name: Charusheel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charusheel हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charusheel is derived from the Sanskrit words 'charu' which means 'desirable' or 'lovable' and 'sheel' which means 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. The name is used in Hindu tradition to honor the divine qualities of love and wisdom.
